drop-zone.instructions: Drop the users .csv here. Please, remember that the .csv must have the following columns in this specific order: <0/><1> Username, Password, First Name, Last Name, DoB (optional. If not exists, leave a blank column), Gender (optional, if not exists, leave a blank column), User SIE (student record number or teacher record number) </1>, and user email (optional). If the institution wants to use Microsoft Teams for video calls, the email provided should match the one used on Teams, and it is mandatory to include the email. These fields should be included in the first row. <0/> The Date of Birth, and Gender are optional. <0/> This is a .CSV file, so be sure that the data of the columns does not have any comma.  Note: This process does not update any password, user school identifier or username. If the user already exists (validated by the user school identifier), the system updates the full name, email, gender, and date of birth if they differ from the information the user has in the database.
